instructions: Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
WILLOWBANK ACTIVITY CAMPS — SUMMER BOOKING

Family name: (1) ........
Age band the child joins: the (2) ........ group
Session starts on: (3) ........
Children handed over at: (4) ........
Price if booked in advance: £(5) ........
Amount payable today: £(6) ........
Payment now made by: (7) ........
Best number to ring during the day: (8) ........
Activity chosen for the fortnight: (9) ........
To bring: a packed lunch on four days, a (10) ........ and a sun hat
Not to be sent with the child: mobile phones, fizzy drinks

items.explanation: The surname is spelled out letter by letter in the recording: F-E-R-R-E-I-R-A.

items.prompt: Age band the child joins: the (2) ........ group
items.evidence: That puts her in the middle age band, which we call the Kingfisher group
items.explanation: The name of the youngest age group is Otters; the eleven-year-old child joins the middle age group, the Kingfisher group.

items.evidence: That was the date we first advertised, but we've put it back by a week — it now begins on Monday the twentieth of July.
items.explanation: The parent had noted the date as 13 July, but the staff member says the start has been put back a week: the camp begins on 20 July.

items.evidence: so drop-off is now quarter past nine
items.explanation: The gates used to open at nine; because of school traffic, drop-off has been moved to quarter past nine.

items.evidence: there's an early booking rate of a hundred and eighty-five
items.explanation: The standard two-week fee is £210; those who book before the end of May pay the early booking rate of £185.

items.evidence: we only take a deposit of thirty pounds to hold the place
items.explanation: Only a £30 deposit is taken today to hold the place; the remaining amount will be paid on the first morning of the camp.

items.evidence: since the spring everything's gone through bank transfer instead
items.explanation: The camp used to accept cards; since spring all payments have been taken by bank transfer.

items.prompt: Best number to ring during the day: (8) ........
items.evidence: My mobile's best: oh seven nine four one, double two six, three one five.
items.explanation: The parent gives their mobile number for daytime contact; 'double two' means two twos, so the number is 07941 226 315.

items.evidence: so put her down for archery
items.explanation: The child's heart was set on canoeing, but because of what her cousin told her, she is signed up for archery instead.

items.prompt: To bring: a packed lunch on four days, a (10) ........ and a sun hat
items.evidence: She'll also want a waterproof jacket
items.explanation: The list of things to bring is given in order: a packed lunch on four days, then a waterproof jacket, then a sun hat and a refillable bottle.

yeniden_uretim.uretilen_grup: L1 dinleme - sizinti onarimi (yalniz kok / secenek / cerceve)
yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: To bring: a (10) ........, a sun hat and a refillable bottle
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Senaryo gösterilmeden 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: 'getirilecekler: bir (10), güneş şapkası ve yeniden doldurulabilir şişe' listesi güneş ve su kalemlerini zaten sayıp geriye tek eksik hava koşulu kalemini bırakıyor.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Cevap (waterproof jacket) ve dayanak noktasi ayni; degisen yalnizca form satiri. Eski satirda bosluk 'gunes sapkasi + su sisesi' ikilisinin yanindaydi: gunes ve su kalemleri zaten yazili oldugu icin geriye tek eksik kategori olarak hava kosulu kalemi kaliyordu ve soru duyulmadan cozuluyordu. Yeni satirda su sisesi yazili degil, yerine oglen yemegi yazili; boylece bosluga hem 'icecek' hem 'yagmurluk' hem 'gunes kremi' gibi birden fazla aday oturuyor. Dinleyen icin ayirt edici olan sira: konusmada kalemler oglen yemegi - yagmurluk - gunes sapkasi - sise diye siralaniyor ve bosluk formda tam olarak yagmurlugun yerinde duruyor. Forma ayrica 'getirilmeyecekler' satiri eklendi; gazli icecek yasagi kor cozucunun tahminini bilerek sise/icecek tarafina cekiyor.
